baseline_models.focus_anchor: The directional construction `إلى ربك` and the definite event noun `المساق` anchor motion to the Lord as its endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship supplies ownership and governing authority, while driving supplies an external force that transfers control of movement away from the traveler.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the governing endpoint and the one with the claim over the movement.
Driving and impelling provide compelled forward motion and loss of self-direction.

changed_reading.before: A journey whose destination is the Lord.
changed_reading.after: An authority-governed conveyance in which the traveler is moved toward the Lord rather than choosing the course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `ربك` and `المساق`, joined by the time marker `يومئذ`, permit the destination and the ordered manner of reaching it to be read together.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nurture and completion make the Lord the one who has managed a being's development, while single-file following makes the conveyance a sequenced final phase rather than an isolated displacement.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion cast the endpoint as the completing administrator of a prior process.
Following one after another supplies an ordered procession and a serial temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The concluding ordered phase of a process governed by the one who nurtures and completes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of `المساق` also carries the image of the leg or supporting stem, while `ربك` can carry staying and lasting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The movement noun can retain an echo of bodily support, so the route is not only abstract transport but the passage of an embodied being toward an abiding endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The leg, shank, or supporting stem gives the conveyance a bodily and load-bearing substrate.
Staying, clinging, and lasting make the endpoint an abiding station rather than another transient waypoint.

changed_reading.before: An abstract transfer toward a destination.
changed_reading.after: An embodied passage whose failing supports are carried toward an abiding endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence closes escape and refuge, then places settlement at the same Lordward endpoint. `المساق` therefore names the compulsory mobile phase of a route with no lateral exit and with a fixed terminus.

activation_trace.role: Driving supplies the compelled transit whose route is narrowed by the context.
Lordship supplies the common authority and endpoint of the transit.
Flight and escape supply the attempted alternative direction that the next clause closes.
Refuge supplies the possible stopping place that is explicitly unavailable.
The repeated Lordward frame locks the earlier settlement and the later conveyance to one governing endpoint.
Fixity and settlement provide the terminus that contrasts with and completes the moving `المساق`.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 moves from a question about escape, through denial of refuge, to `إلى ربك ... المستقر`.
75:12 and 75:30 repeat the Lordward deictic frame while contrasting settlement with conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape, no refuge, Lordward settlement, and Lordward driving; I infer a closed route from motion to rest. A live alternative is that the two clauses are parallel declarations of judgment without describing consecutive phases.

changed_reading.after: The no-exit transit phase that ends in a fixed Lordward settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence reaches a bodily limit, locates rising breath at the collarbone, recognizes separation, and wraps leg with leg. At `المساق`, self-support gives way to being driven: the body crosses from agent of locomotion to object of conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Driving names the external force that takes over when self-motion fails.
The supporting-leg image keeps the transit materially attached to the body.
Lordship identifies who receives authority over the person at the handoff.
Reaching the limit establishes a terminal bodily threshold immediately before the conveyance.
The collarbone where breath rises supplies the vertical respiratory edge of the threshold.
Separation supplies the irreversible relational break that converts approach into departure.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies entanglement and loss of free articulation.
The repeated legs make the root transition from bodily supports in 75:29 to the conveyance noun in 75:30 explicit.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 is an uninterrupted threshold sequence ending in the focus ayah.
The exact root moves from two bodily `ساق` occurrences in 75:29 to `المساق` in 75:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily limit, breath/collarbone, separation, entangled legs, and driving; I infer a handoff from self-supported motion to externally governed conveyance. The live alternative is that the leg image marks distress while `المساق` remains a separate abstract destination noun.

changed_reading.before: A disembodied journey after a terminal event.
changed_reading.after: The threshold handoff in which bodily supports cease to carry the person and the person becomes the carried or driven object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later portrait joins turning away to a self-directed trip toward one's people with an extended, swaggering gait. Its chosen `إلى` movement is reversed by `إلى ربك ... المساق`: familiar belonging yields to the Lord's claim, and proud locomotion yields to impelled motion.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and authority displace the lesser claim represented by the person's household.
Impelling reverses the person's earlier self-directed and performative gait.
Turning away supplies the chosen orientation that the Lordward conveyance overturns.
Going and passing supply voluntary motion in the contrasting `إلى` construction.
Nearness and group belonging provide the provisional social destination displaced by Lordship.
Swagger through bodily extension supplies the posture of autonomous control that driving removes.

structural_cues: 75:30 and 75:33 both use `إلى` to mark a destination, first the Lord and then the person's people.
The conduct report after 75:30 retrospectively contrasts impelled conveyance with denial, turning away, and swaggering departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two destination constructions, voluntary departure to one's people, and swagger; I read their juxtaposition as an agency and allegiance reversal. A live alternative is that 75:31-33 merely supplies prior biography and is not designed as a formal counter-motion to 75:30.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is simply the final destination.
changed_reading.after: The focus is an ironic reversal of chosen homeward swagger: the gait once controlled by the person becomes a driving, and household belonging gives way to the Lord's claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah brackets the focus with gathering and exact formation at the opening and staged generation plus enlivening of the dead at the close. Activated by nurture/completion and serial following, `المساق` becomes a managed transition inside a reversible making sequence, not mere relocation of an already fixed object.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion make the endpoint continuous with the being's formation.
Following in one trace supplies the ordered linkage between successive material states.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies reassembly as one operation in the larger process.
Integrity and completion of form supply precise reconstitution rather than bulk transport.
The generative fluid from which form is apportioned supplies the initial material stage.
Bringing creation into being supplies the formative transformation linking stages.
Animate life supplies the recoverable state on the far side of the transition.
Loss of force and life supplies the state that the closing challenge presents as reversible.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 opens with disputed bodily gathering and precise re-formation.
75:37-40 closes with a sequence from generative fluid through creation and proportion to the enlivening of the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formation, dissolution, reassembly, and renewed life; I infer that the focus conveyance is a governed transition within that sequence. The live alternative is that the creation frame proves authority over the destination without specifying what `المساق` itself does.

changed_reading.before: Transport of a stable person from one location to another.
changed_reading.after: A sequenced transfer under the same completing authority that can disassemble, gather, reform, and reanimate the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired face scenes present two orientations before the common Lordward conveyance: one face directs perception toward its Lord, while another contracts in aversion and anticipates a back-breaking event. The route is shared, but its experienced mode differs with prior orientation.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the common endpoint before which the contrasting orientations are exposed.
Driving supplies the common external route regardless of the traveler's disposition.
The face scene names the same Lordward endpoint before the focus repeats it.
Face as direction turns visible countenance into an orientation toward the coming endpoint.
Directed sight or insight supplies willing perceptual orientation toward the Lord.
The contracted, hateful expression supplies resistant affect before the same day of arrival.
The back-breaking calamity supplies the feared mode in which compelled arrival is anticipated.

structural_cues: 75:22-25 balances two face clauses, one radiant and Lordward-looking and one grimacing in expectation.
The Lordward phrase in 75:23 precedes and anticipates the Lordward conveyance phrase in 75:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting faces, directed perception, feared breaking, and a shared Lordward endpoint; I infer that orientation changes the experienced mode of the same arrival. A live alternative is that the two face outcomes are separate verdicts rather than postures toward `المساق`.

changed_reading.after: A common Lordward conveyance experienced either as already-faced approach or as resisted, breaking compulsion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a revelation-handling sequence into an eschatological movement. It remains anchored in the focus through the serial-following branch of `المساق` and the completing-care branch of `ربك`, with explicit context stages of collection, recitation, following, and clarification. Render it only as a process analogy, not as a lexical translation of `المساق`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `المساق` can carry following one after another, and `ربك` can carry administration toward completion.

activation_trace.role: Serial following anchors the focus as an ordered convoy rather than an instantaneous displacement.
Care and completion assign the sequence to a governing completer.
Collection of dispersed material supplies the first externally governed stage.
Recitation supplies the ordered content handed through the sequence.
Succession and following supply the mandated response to the prior stage.
Clarifying meaning supplies completion after collection and following.

changed_reading.before: A forceful movement with no internal articulation.
changed_reading.after: An ordered convoy whose stages are gathered, handed on, followed, and brought to disclosure under Lordly administration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped `ر ب و` branch under focus `ربك` and couples it to respiratory and leg images. It remains formally anchored by packet-supplied focus branches for both `ربك` and `المساق`, then gains local support from the collarbone and paired-leg sequence. Render it as a contained somatic echo, never as the direct lexical sense of `ربك`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for focus `ربك` includes breath-swelling, while focus `المساق` includes both driving and the supporting leg.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant breath-swelling image supplies a respiratory echo at the Lordward endpoint.
The leg or supporting stem supplies the lower bodily support system echoed immediately before the focus.
Breath rising at the collarbone supplies the upper respiratory threshold.
The paired legs supply the lower supports that converge with the respiratory threshold before `المساق`.

changed_reading.before: A movement described independently of bodily subsystems.
changed_reading.after: A somatic convergence in which rising breath and failing lower supports funnel the embodied person into Lordward conveyance.

strongest_changes: The exact `س و ق` recurrence turns the paired legs of 75:29 into the material handoff to the driving of 75:30.
The no-escape sequence and the repeated `إلى ربك` frame distinguish moving `المساق` from fixed `المستقر`.
The voluntary trip toward one's people in 75:33 reverses into compelled motion toward the Lord in 75:30.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed three interacting geometries around the focus: a closed route from escape to settlement, a bodily threshold from breath and legs to conveyance, and mirrored chosen versus compelled destination clauses. It also preserved process analogies to reconstitution and recitation that a narrow death-scene reading would miss.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `المساق` foregrounds the act of driving, the course, or the terminal event remains grammatically open in this trace.
The reconstitution and recitation models may be framing analogies rather than mechanisms internal to the focus noun.
The breath-support outlier depends on a deliberately form-distant non-dominant mapped branch and requires explicit qualification.
